intent: Cluster test for the blocking-queue time-based rate limiter: verifies SetBlockingQueueTimeRateLimit's window/threshold settings round-trip through Status, and that a burst of conflicting commands sharing an identifier trips per-identifier blocking once its threshold is exceeded.

objects.name: BlockingQueueRateLimitTest::before
objects.role: runs before each TEST(): clears rate-limit state and resets conflict retries

objects.name: BlockingQueueRateLimitTest::testControlCommands
objects.role: sets window/threshold values and checks they round-trip through Status

objects.name: BlockingQueueRateLimitTest::testTimeRateLimiting
objects.role: forces conflicts on a shared identifier from three threads, checks some requests are refused (503) and the identifier shows blocked

naming_quality.note: clear, consistent with sibling control-command tests
